whatChangedAndWhy: Three changes, all made and reported rather than asked. (1) Strategy PR #5465: a thread window now gets ONE paired beat instead of "2 slots" — that rule was written when an IG item and an X item each took their own slot, and since the 2026-10-05 one-beat grammar it had silently doubled to four posts per thread. Evidence: planning this fortnight against the old numbers produced 19 demands for 13 slots, and the visible symptom was Runway dropped entirely in September and Clue Web getting 1 of its 2 October slots. (2) Same PR, strategy-params: site-screens are now allowed on `mood:` campaigns, not just `launch:` — the launch-only allowlist made §1(d)'s `mood:result` format ("the real returned songs as slide 2") literally undraftable, and Mood has never shipped a post in this desk's existence. (3) social/lessons.md: L001 (photo reuse) retires as CODIFIED — its codify issue #4601 closed and the check landed as check-drafts.mjs:checkPhotoReuse, so the gate enforces it now instead of a prompt. New rule L002 from your 10-06 ❌ ("Don't show me posts that I can't reply to"): never surface a reply target that is locked or archived.
